name: Python-to-Markdown API Docs Generator
description: Walks a Python codebase and writes Markdown API documentation from its syntax trees: modules, classes, functions, type hints, defaults, docstrings, TODOs, and what each function calls.
highlights: Parses source with ast instead of importing it, so heavy or broken modules can still be documented
Reads config descriptions straight out of dataclass field metadata
Lists what every function calls or instantiates, and collects TODO and FIXME comments with line numbers via tokenize
